```{r}
library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
library(VGAM)
library(broom)
library(gtsummary)
library(nnet)
```

# read files

```{r}
w70 <- read_sav("ATP W70.sav")
w84 <- read_sav("ATP W84.sav")
```

# EDA

```{r}
#| label: initial plots for presentation 1
df <- w70 %>% 
  select(ATTENDMONTH_W70,ATTENDONLINE_W70,F_RELIG,F_SEX,F_AGECAT)%>% 
  filter(if_all(everything(), ~ .x != 99)) %>% 
  filter(F_RELIG == 1|F_RELIG == 2)

df2 <- w84 %>%
  select(ATTENDMONTH_W84,ATTENDONLINE_W84,F_RELIG,F_GENDER,F_AGECAT)%>% 
  filter(if_all(everything(), ~ .x != 99)) %>% 
  filter(F_RELIG == 1|F_RELIG == 2)


#Attend form VS Religion ONLINE (WAVE70)
ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(F_RELIG), fill = factor(ATTENDONLINE_W70))) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(
    stat = "count",
    aes(label = after_stat(count)),          
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Respondents Attending Online Worship by Religion(July 2020)",
    x = "Religious Group",
    y = "Number of People",
    fill = "Attended Online"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("1" = "Protestant", "2" = "Roman Catholic")) +
  scale_fill_discrete(labels = c("1" = "Yes", "2" = "No")) +   # 👈 这一行
  theme_minimal()

#Attend form VS Religion ONLINE (WAVE84)
ggplot(df2, aes(x = factor(F_RELIG), fill = factor(ATTENDONLINE_W84))) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(
    stat = "count",
    aes(label = after_stat(count)),          
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Respondents Attending Online Worship by Religion(March 2021)",
    x = "Religious Group",
    y = "Number of People",
    fill = "Attended Online"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("1" = "Protestant", "2" = "Roman Catholic")) +
  scale_fill_discrete(labels = c("1" = "Yes", "2" = "No")) +   
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
w70_cp <- w70 %>%
  filter(F_RELIG %in% c(1,2))%>%
  filter(ATTENDMONTH_W70 != 99, ATTENDONLINE_W70 != 99)
w70_cp %>%
  group_by(ATTENDMONTH_W70) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_month = mean(ATTENDMONTH_W70, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_month = sd(ATTENDMONTH_W70, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

w70_cp %>%
  group_by(ATTENDONLINE_W70) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_month = mean(ATTENDONLINE_W70, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_month = sd(ATTENDONLINE_W70, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: create clean dataset with attendmonth,attendonline (1/0)

w70_cp_attend <- w70_cp
w70_cp_attend$ATTENDMONTH_W70 <- as.character(w70_cp_attend$ATTENDMONTH_W70)
w70_cp_attend$ATTENDMONTH_bin <- ifelse(
  w70_cp_attend$ATTENDMONTH_W70 == "1",
  1, 0
)
```

```{r}
#| label: COVIDCONG2_W70

# COVIDCONG2_W70 
# Regardless of whether it is now open to the public, is the house of worship you attend most often CURRENTLY streaming or recording its services so that people can watch them online or on TV?
sum_stream <- w70_cp %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(COVIDCONG2_W70),
    F_RELIG %in% c(1, 2)
  ) %>%
  count(F_RELIG, COVIDCONG2_W70, name = "count") %>%
  group_by(F_RELIG) %>%
  mutate(
    n = sum(count),
    prop = count / n,
    se = sqrt(prop * (1 - prop) / n)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      count, "\n(",
      scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1),
      ")"
    )
  )

ggplot(
  sum_stream,
  aes(
    x = factor(F_RELIG),
    y = count,
    fill = factor(COVIDCONG2_W70)
  )
) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = count - n * se,
      ymax = count + n * se
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    width = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    vjust = -0.35,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Congregations Streaming or Recording Services Online by Religion (July 2020)",
    x = "Religious Group",
    y = "Number of Respondents",
    fill = "Church Streams or Records Services"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "1" = "Protestant",
    "2" = "Roman Catholic"
  )) +
  scale_fill_discrete(labels = c(
    "1" = "Yes",
    "2" = "No"
  )) +
  theme_minimal()


# analysis
model_1b <- glm(ATTENDMONTH_bin ~ factor(COVIDCONG2_W70), data = w70_cp_attend, family = binomial, weights = WEIGHT_W70)

summary(model_1b)

model_1 <- glm(ATTENDMONTH_bin ~ factor(COVIDCONG2_W70), data = w70_cp_attend, family = binomial)

summary(model_1)

```

```{r}
#| label: COVIDCONG3_W70
# COVIDCONG3_W70. 
# Which of the following best describes the current operating status of the house of worship you attend most often?


sum_w70 <- w70_cp %>%
  filter(!is.na(COVIDCONG3_W70),
         F_RELIG %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
  count(F_RELIG, COVIDCONG3_W70, name = "count") %>%
  group_by(F_RELIG) %>%
  mutate(
    n = sum(count),
    prop = count / n,
    se = sqrt(prop * (1 - prop) / n)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      count, "\n(",
      scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1),
      ")"
    )
  )

ggplot(
  sum_w70,
  aes(
    x = factor(F_RELIG),
    y = count,
    fill = factor(COVIDCONG3_W70)
  )
) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = count - n * se,
      ymax = count + n * se
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    width = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    vjust = -0.35,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Operating Status of Congregations by Religion (July 2020)",
    x = "Religious Group",
    y = "Number of Respondents",
    fill = "Operating Status of House of Worship"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "1" = "Protestant",
    "2" = "Roman Catholic"
  )) +
  scale_fill_discrete(labels = c(
    "1" = "Open as before COVID-19",
    "2" = "Open with modifications",
    "3" = "Not open for in-person services",
    "4" = "Not sure",
    "99" = "Refused"
  )) +
  theme_minimal()



model_2 <- glm(
  ATTENDMONTH_bin ~ factor(COVIDCONG3_W70),
  data = w70_cp_attend,
  family = binomial
)
summary(model_2)
```

```{r}
    prop = count / n,

  ) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(

    )
  )
```

```{r}
df_sum <- df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(F_RELIG) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(N_relig = n()) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(F_RELIG, ATTENDONLINE_W70) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = n(),                 # count
    N = first(N_relig),
    prop = n / N,            # proportion
    se = sqrt(prop * (1 - prop) / N),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
ggplot(df_sum,
       aes(
         x = factor(F_RELIG),
         y = n,
         fill = factor(ATTENDONLINE_W70)
       )) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = paste0(
        scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1),
        "\n(SE = ",
        scales::percent(se, accuracy = 0.1),
        ")"
      )
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Respondents Attending Online Worship by Religion (July 2020)",
    x = "Religious Group",
    y = "Number of Respondents",
    fill = "Attended Online"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("1" = "Protestant", "2" = "Roman Catholic")
  ) +
  scale_fill_discrete(
    labels = c("1" = "Yes", "2" = "No")
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
    aes(
      label = paste0(
        scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1),
        "\n(SE = ",
        scales::percent(se, accuracy = 0.1),
        ")"
      )
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Respondents Attending Online Worship by Religion (March 2021)",
    x = "Religious Group",
    y = "Number of Respondents",
    fill = "Attended Online"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("1" = "Protestant", "2" = "Roman Catholic")
  ) +
  scale_fill_discrete(
    labels = c("1" = "Yes", "2" = "No")
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```


## \# EDA end

# create attend variable in w70

```{r}

#| label: create respond variable attend

library(nnet)
w70_cp <- w70 %>% 
  filter(F_RELIG %in% c(1,2)) %>% 
  filter(ATTENDMONTH_W70 != 99, ATTENDONLINE_W70 != 99) %>%
  mutate(attend = case_when(
    ATTENDMONTH_W70 == 1 & ATTENDONLINE_W70 == 1 ~ "Both",
    ATTENDMONTH_W70 == 1 & ATTENDONLINE_W70 == 2 ~ "In-person only",
    ATTENDMONTH_W70 == 2 & ATTENDONLINE_W70 == 1 ~ "Online only",
    ATTENDMONTH_W70 == 2 & ATTENDONLINE_W70 == 2 ~ "Neither"
  )) %>%
  mutate(attend = factor(attend, 
                         levels = c("In-person only", "Online only", "Both", "Neither")))
w70_cp$attend <- relevel(w70_cp$attend, ref = "In-person only")
table(w70_cp$attend)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# ATTENDMONTH_W70 = attend mass in person
# ATTENDONLINE_W70 = attend mass online
#
# attend codes:
# 1 -> attend in person = 1, online = 1  (attend both)
# 2 -> attend in person = 1, online = 2  (only in person)
# 3 -> attend in person = 2, online = 1  (only online)
# 4 -> attend in person = 2, online = 2  (attend neither)
#
# Note: rows with v1 == 99 or v2 == 99 are removed
# ------------------------------------------------------------

```

```{r}
attend_counts <- w70_cp %>%
  count(attend) %>%
  mutate(
    N = sum(n),
    prop = n / N,
    se = sqrt(prop * (1 - prop) / N)
  )


attend_counts <- attend_counts %>%
  mutate(
    prop_pct = prop * 100,
    se_pct = se * 100
  )

ggplot(attend_counts, aes(x = attend, y = prop)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = prop - se, ymax = prop + se),
    width = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = sprintf("%.1f%%\n(SE = %.2f%%)", prop_pct, se_pct)
    ),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 3.8
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Attendance Patterns (Wave 70)",
    x = "Attendance Type",
    y = "Share of Respondents"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# h1 model

```{r}
#| label: Hypothesis 1

# Step 1: 清除含有 99 的观测
w70_cp_clean <- w70_cp %>%
  filter(if_all(c(
    ATTENDCONF_W70, COVIDCONG3_W70, COVIDCONG4_W70,
    CONGRESTRICT2_a_W70, CONGRESTRICT2_b_W70, CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70,
    CTKNOW1_W70, CONTACTTRAC1_W70,
    SERMONISSUE_a_W70, SERMONISSUE_b_W70, SERMONISSUE_c_W70,
    SERMONISSUE_d_W70, SERMONISSUE_e_W70, SERMONISSUE_f_W70
  ), ~ . != 99))

# Step 2: 转为 factor
w70_cp_clean <- w70_cp_clean %>%
  mutate(across(c(
    ATTENDCONF_W70, COVIDCONG3_W70, COVIDCONG4_W70,
    CONGRESTRICT2_a_W70, CONGRESTRICT2_b_W70, CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70,
    CTKNOW1_W70, CONTACTTRAC1_W70,
    SERMONISSUE_a_W70, SERMONISSUE_b_W70, SERMONISSUE_c_W70,
    SERMONISSUE_d_W70, SERMONISSUE_e_W70, SERMONISSUE_f_W70
  ), as.factor))

# Step 3: 设置 reference 类别
w70_cp_clean$attend <- relevel(w70_cp_clean$attend, ref = "In-person only")

# Step 4: 自动检测并移除只有一个水平的变量
vars_h1 <- c(
  "ATTENDCONF_W70", "COVIDCONG3_W70", "COVIDCONG4_W70",
  "CONGRESTRICT2_a_W70", "CONGRESTRICT2_b_W70", "CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70",
  "CTKNOW1_W70", "CONTACTTRAC1_W70",
  "SERMONISSUE_a_W70", "SERMONISSUE_b_W70", "SERMONISSUE_c_W70",
  "SERMONISSUE_d_W70", "SERMONISSUE_e_W70", "SERMONISSUE_f_W70"
)

# 检查每个变量的水平数
level_counts <- sapply(w70_cp_clean[, vars_h1], nlevels)
invalid_vars <- names(level_counts[level_counts <= 1])

if (length(invalid_vars) > 0) {
  message("⚠️ 以下变量只有一个水平，被自动移除: ", paste(invalid_vars, collapse = ", "))
}

valid_vars <- setdiff(vars_h1, invalid_vars)

# Step 5: 动态建立 formula
formula_h1 <- as.formula(paste("attend ~", paste(valid_vars, collapse = " + ")))

# Step 6: 拟合模型
model_h1 <- multinom(formula_h1, data = w70_cp_clean)

# Step 7: 输出 summary 与显著性
summary(model_h1)

# check p-values to find statstical significant variables
tidy(model_h1, conf.int = TRUE) %>% print(n = 42)
```

# predict table h1

```{r}
#| label: predictor table for h1 w70

library(dplyr)
library(nnet)
library(gtsummary)

w70_h1 <- w70_cp_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # 1️⃣ 出席信心
    ATTENDCONF_W70 = factor(
      ATTENDCONF_W70,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
      labels = c("Very confident",
                 "Somewhat confident",
                 "Not too confident",
                 "Not at all confident")
    ),

    # 2️⃣ 教会防疫行动
    COVIDCONG3_W70 = factor(
      COVIDCONG3_W70,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
      labels = c("No actions",
                 "Some actions",
                 "Many actions",
                 "Extensive actions")
    ),

    # 3️⃣ 教会限制措施
    CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70 = factor(
      CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
      labels = c("No restrictions",
                 "Minor restrictions",
                 "Major restrictions",
                 "Severe restrictions")
    ),

    # 4️⃣ 接触追踪
    CONTACTTRAC1_W70 = factor(
      CONTACTTRAC1_W70,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("Support contact tracing",
                 "Do not support")
    ),

    # 5️⃣ 布道主题 c: COVID 防控
    SERMONISSUE_c_W70 = factor(
      SERMONISSUE_c_W70,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("Heard sermons on limiting COVID spread",
                 "Did not hear such sermons")
    ),

    # 6️⃣ 布道主题 f: 其他议题
    SERMONISSUE_f_W70 = factor(
      SERMONISSUE_f_W70,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("Heard sermons on other topics",
                 "Did not hear such sermons")
    ) 
  )

#set "did not hear" as reference 
w70_h1$SERMONISSUE_c_W70 <- relevel(
  w70_h1$SERMONISSUE_c_W70,
  ref = "Did not hear such sermons"
)
w70_h1$SERMONISSUE_f_W70 <- relevel(
  w70_h1$SERMONISSUE_f_W70,
  ref = "Did not hear such sermons"
)
w70_h1$CONTACTTRAC1_W70 <- relevel(
  w70_h1$CONTACTTRAC1_W70,
  ref = "Do not support"
)

model_h1_sub <- multinom(
  attend ~ ATTENDCONF_W70 + COVIDCONG3_W70 +
    CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70 + CONTACTTRAC1_W70 +
    SERMONISSUE_c_W70 + SERMONISSUE_f_W70,
  data = w70_h1
)

tbl_regression(
  model_h1_sub,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  label = list(
    ATTENDCONF_W70 ~ "Confidence in attending safely",
    COVIDCONG3_W70 ~ "Congregation’s COVID safety actions",
    CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70 ~ "Congregational restrictions",
    CONTACTTRAC1_W70 ~ "Contact tracing support",
    SERMONISSUE_c_W70 ~ "Sermon topic: limiting COVID spread",
    SERMONISSUE_f_W70 ~ "Sermon topic: other issues"
  )
) %>%
  modify_caption("**Predictors of Online and Hybrid Attendance (Refused Responses Removed)**") %>%
  bold_labels()


```

```{r}
  )) %>%

# Relevel
w84_cp$attend <- relevel(w84_cp$attend, ref = "In-person only")
### 通用函数（你已经在用的）
run_multinom <- function(data, vars) {
  clean <- data %>% filter(if_all(all_of(vars), ~ . != 99))

  clean <- clean %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(vars), as.factor))

  clean$attend <- relevel(clean$attend, ref = "In-person only")

  lv <- sapply(clean[, vars], nlevels)
  vars_valid <- names(lv[lv > 1])

  fml <- as.formula(paste("attend ~", paste(vars_valid, collapse = " + ")))

  model <- multinom(fml, data = clean)

  return(list(model = model, vars = vars_valid, data = clean))
}
```

#12.2 update

```{r}
# function 
run_multinom_model <- function(data, outcome_var, predictor_vars, ref_level = "In-person only") {
  library(nnet)
  library(dplyr)
  
  # Step 1: remove 99
  data_clean <- data %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(predictor_vars), ~ . != 99))

  # Step 2: convert predictors to factor
  data_clean <- data_clean %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(predictor_vars), as.factor))

  # Step 3: set reference category for outcome
  data_clean[[outcome_var]] <- relevel(as.factor(data_clean[[outcome_var]]), ref = ref_level)

  # Step 4: drop predictors with only 1 level
  level_counts <- sapply(data_clean[, predictor_vars, drop = FALSE], nlevels)
  invalid_vars <- names(level_counts[level_counts <= 1])

  if (length(invalid_vars) > 0) {
    message("⚠️ Dropped variables (only 1 level): ",
            paste(invalid_vars, collapse = ", "))
  }

  valid_vars <- setdiff(predictor_vars, invalid_vars)

  # Step 5: build formula
  formula_obj <- as.formula(
    paste(outcome_var, "~", paste(valid_vars, collapse = " + "))
  )

  # Step 6: fit multinom model
  model <- multinom(formula_obj, data = data_clean)

  # Step 7: return model & summary
  list(
    model = model,
    summary = summary(model),
    valid_vars = valid_vars,
    dropped_vars = invalid_vars
  )
}
```

```{r}
# setup
w70_cp <- w70_cp %>%
  mutate(
    CONGRESTRICT2_a_W70 = ifelse(CONGRESTRICT2_a_W70 == 99, NA, CONGRESTRICT2_a_W70),
    CONGRESTRICT2_b_W70 = ifelse(CONGRESTRICT2_b_W70 == 99, NA, CONGRESTRICT2_b_W70),
    CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70 = ifelse(CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70 == 99, NA, CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70),
    
    # recode: Yes=1, No=0, Not sure=0
    CONGRESTRICT2_a_rec = ifelse(CONGRESTRICT2_a_W70 == 1, 1, 0),
    CONGRESTRICT2_b_rec = ifelse(CONGRESTRICT2_b_W70 == 1, 1, 0),
    CONGRESTRICT2_c_rec = ifelse(CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70 == 1, 1, 0),

    # combine: total restrictions
    CONGRESTRICT2_total_W70 = CONGRESTRICT2_a_rec +
                              CONGRESTRICT2_b_rec +
                              CONGRESTRICT2_c_rec
  )%>%
  mutate(
    # remove refused (optional)
    COVIDCONG3_W70 = ifelse(COVIDCONG3_W70 == 99, NA, COVIDCONG3_W70),

    # 1: not open
    COVIDCONG3_notopen = ifelse(COVIDCONG3_W70 == 3, 1, 0),

    # 2: open with changes
    COVIDCONG3_open_changed = ifelse(COVIDCONG3_W70 == 2, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # remove refused
    COVIDTHREAT_a_W70 = ifelse(COVIDTHREAT_a_W70 == 99, NA, COVIDTHREAT_a_W70),
    COVIDTHREAT_b_W70 = ifelse(COVIDTHREAT_b_W70 == 99, NA, COVIDTHREAT_b_W70),

    COVIDTHREAT_health_cat = case_when(
      COVIDTHREAT_a_W70 == 1 | COVIDTHREAT_b_W70 == 1 ~ 1, # major
      COVIDTHREAT_a_W70 == 2 | COVIDTHREAT_b_W70 == 2 ~ 2, # minor
      COVIDTHREAT_a_W70 == 3 & COVIDTHREAT_b_W70 == 3 ~ 3, # not a threat
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

  


w70_c <- w70_cp %>%
  filter(F_RELIG == 2)
w70_p <- w70_cp %>%
  filter(F_RELIG == 1)
```

```{r}
    N = sum(n),
    prop = n / N,

    se_pct = se * 100
  )

ggplot(attend_counts, aes(x = attend, y = prop)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = prop - se, ymax = prop + se),

  ) +
  geom_text(

    ),
    vjust = -0.4,

  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
```
